description: I'm Aman, the architect behind the Sheridan Swiftie Club and proud to serve as its President. As we celebrate the club's 1st anniversary, I'm thrilled about the exciting events and meetups we have planned this fall. It's been an amazing journey, and I can't wait to see how we continue to grow this vibrant community!

Hi, I'm Vidhi, your VP of Events! Organizing events and boosting engagement is my passion. As we head into this new semester, I'm excited to host memorable events and foster even more participation within our community. Let's make this year full of amazing Swiftie moments!

Hey there! I'm Cris, your VP of Engagement, and I'm super excited to connect with fellow Swifties this year. I love discussing music with no judgment, especially Taylor Swift's! I can't wait to meet new faces and create awesome memories with everyone. Let's make this year unforgettable!

Hello, I'm Siddharth, the Events Lead at SSC. I'm looking forward to getting to know all the new members and collaborating with everyone to create some unforgettable events this year. Let's make this fall semester a great one for all Swifties!

Hi, I'm Benafsha! Currently enrolled in the Public Relations program working towards becoming a PR pro who loves connecting with people and creating positive vibes. When I'm not studying, you'll probably find me with a book, checking out new restaurants, or planning my next trip. Oh, and I'm a huge Taylor Swift fan—I start my day with songs from the Reputation album and end the day with Midnights! I feel like I'm definitely between the Reputation and Midnights eras. Reputation speaks to me because it's all about reclaiming your power and owning who you are. On the other hand, Midnights feels dreamy, representing those late-night thoughts and reflections about growth, love, and uncertainty. Both eras together just feel like the perfect mix of strength and self-discovery right now! I'm looking forward to meeting fellow Swifties and bonding over our favorite Taylor Swift songs this fall term! I'm excited for the themed events or album listening parties we might have and just sharing all Eras love. Plus, it'll be great to make new connections with people who share the same passion! What about you?

Hi, I’m Harry, a Computer Science undergrad by day and a proud Swiftie 24/7. My favorite Taylor Swift song? “Willow” – it’s pure magic, just like her! Honestly, she’s fire, and I’m here for all of it yes, I might’ve cried during her concert livestream (ps.don’t judge).

Hi, I'm Aditya, your Social Media Manager. Designing graphics and animations is my passion, and I'm excited to create engaging content for the club. Let's make sure SSC's presence shines online and keeps everyone connected and excited for what's next!

Hey, I'm Tanya, and I'm thrilled to be the club's Advisor this year. I'm embracing my own personal growth journey, much like Taylor in her *1989* era. I look forward to advising the club and ensuring we continue to have impactful events and a strong presence on campus.
